$comment: Interventions dari The Mom Test (mapping §5). expected_evidence wajib = hook Outcome Learning Store.

interventions.name: Customer Slicing sampai who-where pair
interventions.expected_evidence: 1 specific segment with a concrete physical/digital location + ≥3 conversations with consistent problems/goals
interventions.contraindicated_until: Sudah ada who-where pair tervalidasi + ≥3 percakapan konsisten — slicing ulang tanpa sinyal baru hanya menunda kontak pertama

interventions.name: Batch 3-5 customer conversations (Mom Test rules, ≤2 minggu)
interventions.expected_evidence: ≥N fakta behavioral tercatat (bukan compliment/fluff); 0 compliment dihitung sebagai data; list of 3 terjawab
interventions.contraindicated_until: Segmen sudah who-where pair (TM-I01 selesai) — percakapan pada segmen kabur = sinyal campur aduk

interventions.name: Commitment ask di akhir setiap percakapan
interventions.expected_evidence: ≥1 commitment currency didapat (intro decision maker / case study / LOI / pre-order / deposit) ATAU rejection eksplisit — keduanya valid, wishy-washy tidak
interventions.contraindicated_until: Segmen belum jelas (TM-I01 belum selesai) — meminta commitment dari orang yang salah segmen menghasilkan commitment murah yang menyesatkan pipeline

interventions.name: Snowball intro (end every conversation with 'who else should I talk to?')
interventions.expected_evidence: Rasio warm:cold intros naik setelah 2 percakapan pertama; pipeline percakapan berikutnya terisi tanpa cold outreach
interventions.contraindicated_until: Belum ada ≥1 percakapan Mom-Test berkualitas — minta intro dari percakapan kosong menghasilkan intro dingin berlabel hangat

interventions.name: Immerse di tempat segment berada (hadir/organisir event komunitas)
interventions.expected_evidence: ≥5 percakapan customer diperoleh dari 1 venue/event; kredibilitas industri naik (diukur dari respons meeting request)
interventions.contraindicated_until: Segmen sudah who-where pair — lokasi imersi = komponen 'where' dari pair

interventions.name: VFWPA meeting request for senior/decision maker targets
interventions.expected_evidence: Meeting terjadi dengan budget owner / decision maker; ≥1 pertanyaan budget terjawab ('dari mana uangnya, siapa veto holder')
interventions.contraindicated_until: Masalah spesifik belum terkonfirmasi dari percakapan awal — meeting decision-maker tanpa hipotesis masalah = membakar akses senior

interventions.name: Goal-to-first-step backmap (single written milestone)
interventions.expected_evidence: One page containing: the goal with a date, the single next customer-contact step that moves it, and the metric that tells them the path is working — reviewed after that step is actually taken
interventions.contraindicated_until: Goal revenue belum bernomor & bertenggat — backmap tanpa target terukur menghasilkan milestone kosong
